programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga

programme.title: Antim Nyay

programme.title: Krishna Arjun

programme.title: Pardesi

programme.title: Sultanat

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat

programme.title: Hiraasat

programme.title: World's Weirdest

programme.title: America's National Parks

programme.title: Heartland Docs

programme.title: Great Britain From Above

programme.title: Big Cat Planet

programme.title: Bizarre Animal Friends

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Columbus

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: Staff confront a passenger who's travelling on a fake passport. And, six years after it was bought, the first Emirates Airlines Airbus is given a thorough maintenance check. (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: Yukon Vet

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Columbus
programme.desc: Love is a Cheetah Cub: The zoo goes wild for three cute cheetah cubs. But it's not all good news. Staff fight to save Arctic fox Anana, and monkey Finnick needs emergency care. (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: Tiger Shark Terror

programme.title: Shark Eat Shark

programme.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue

programme.title: Lawless Island

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol

programme.title: Yukon Vet
